factor_spec.description: Equal-weighted sum of the directionally oriented ALPHA158-CORR30 volume-price correlation and ALPHA158-KSFT2 close-location signals, using a 40-day correlation window.
factor_spec.name: Oriented Volume-Price and Close-Location Composite

mutation.diagnosis: The intermediate combines complementary volume-price and close-location information, but the 30-day correlation window may be somewhat sensitive to short-term fluctuations. A modestly longer window can improve stability while preserving both parent mechanisms and their directional orientations.

expected_metric_effects.cross_horizon_consistency: Expected to remain strong because both parent mechanisms and their orientations are preserved.
expected_metric_effects.monthly_stability: Expected to improve modestly from smoother estimation of the volume-price relationship.
expected_metric_effects.rank_ic: Expected to remain positive, with potentially less sensitivity to transient volume-price conditions.
expected_metric_effects.rank_icir: Expected to improve modestly if the longer correlation estimate reduces signal noise.

mutation.mutation_description: Changed only the volume-price correlation window from 30 to 40 days; every operator, field, value, min_periods setting, and other window remains unchanged.

crossover.complementarity_analysis: ALPHA158-BETA60 measures the normalized long-horizon price trend through a 60-day regression slope, capturing persistent directional drift. ALPHA158-CNTD5 measures very short-horizon directional consistency by contrasting recent up-day and down-day frequencies. Their low median absolute Spearman correlation of 0.0868 indicates that they contain largely distinct information: one reflects trend magnitude and persistence, while the other reflects immediate path consistency. Both have positive predictive rank IC under their supplied training direction of -1, so both are explicitly negated before combination.

expected_metric_effects.cross_horizon_consistency: Expected to improve or remain strong because the 60-day trend component provides persistence while the 5-day component adds timely confirmation.
expected_metric_effects.monthly_stability: Expected to improve modestly through diversification of medium- and short-horizon information.
expected_metric_effects.rank_ic: Expected to remain positive across 5-day, 10-day, and 20-day horizons by combining two individually consistent oriented signals.
expected_metric_effects.signal_robustness: Expected to improve because cross-sectional ranking limits the influence of scale differences and extreme slope values.

crossover.integration_logic: Each parent formula is first negated to preserve its supplied training direction, then cross-sectionally ranked so the differently scaled signals contribute comparably. The two oriented ranks are added, giving equal material weight to medium-term normalized trend and short-term directional persistence without using future observations.

factor_spec.description: Equal-weight cross-sectional blend of the direction-preserving ranks of normalized 60-day price trend and 5-day directional consistency.
factor_spec.name: Oriented Trend and Directional Persistence Blend

factor_spec.description: Normalized 40-day linear slope of closing price, preserving the original trend-following mechanism while reducing lag relative to the 60-day specification.
factor_spec.name: Qlib Alpha158 BETA40 Refined

refinement.change_description: Shorten the slope lookback from 60 to 40 trading days to improve responsiveness while retaining the normalized price-trend mechanism.
refinement.diagnosis: The 60-day normalized price-trend slope has strong and consistent predictive efficacy, but its lower 5-day rank IC and moderate monthly stability suggest that the long window may respond too slowly to medium-term trend changes.

expected_metric_effects.coverage: Unchanged after the adjusted 39-day effective lookback is available.
expected_metric_effects.monthly_stability: Expected modest improvement or maintenance if the shorter window captures regime changes more promptly.
expected_metric_effects.rank_ic_10d: Expected to remain positive with potentially modest improvement from reduced lag.
expected_metric_effects.rank_ic_20d: Expected to remain positive, though possibly slightly less stable than the original longer window.
expected_metric_effects.rank_ic_5d: Expected improvement from faster adaptation to medium-term price trends.

refinement.preserved_core_logic: The factor remains the linear slope of close over time, normalized by the current close price; only the slope window is changed, with direction, rebalance frequency, portfolio rules, and data requirements preserved.

factor_spec.description: Daily close-location factor, attenuated when the close does not exceed the open. The original high-low range positioning mechanism is preserved while adding same-day price-action confirmation.
factor_spec.name: Qlib Alpha158 KSFT2 with Price-Action Confirmation

refinement.change_description: Multiply the original close-location signal by a confirmation weight of 1.0 when close exceeds open and 0.5 otherwise, using only same-day OHLC data.
refinement.diagnosis: The parent captures close location within the daily high-low range and has strong, consistent rank IC, but it can be noisy when the close is weak relative to the open. A lightweight price-action confirmation can reduce exposure to less supportive daily bars without changing the underlying close-location mechanism.

expected_metric_effects.coverage: Expected to remain unchanged because the confirmation uses available OHLC fields and does not introduce a rolling warm-up period.
expected_metric_effects.monthly_stability: Expected to improve modestly by attenuating less-confirmed observations.
expected_metric_effects.rank_ic: Expected to improve modestly by filtering weaker daily price-action contexts.
expected_metric_effects.rank_icir: Expected to improve through reduced noise and more stable cross-sectional ordering.

refinement.preserved_core_logic: The core signal remains (2*close-high-low)/(high-low+1e-12), preserving its interpretation as the close location within the daily trading range. The added multiplier only confirms or attenuates the signal based on same-day close-versus-open price action.
